summary.name: Personal Computer (Perplexity for Mac)
summary.one_liner: A local AI agent built into the Perplexity Mac app that is summoned with a keyboard shortcut and can read local files, operate native Mac apps, and drive the Comet browser.
use_cases: Search, read and write files in a chosen local folder
Control Mail, Notes, Messages, Finder and Slack with AI
Run research and web automation through Comet browser
Start and monitor Mac tasks remotely from an iPhone
summary.what_it_does: Personal Computer is an always-on AI agent in the Perplexity macOS app that runs on the user's Mac, including a Mac mini, and is opened with one keyboard shortcut from anywhere. It can connect to chosen folders to search, read and write files, and can operate native Mac apps such as Mail, Notes, Messages and Finder. It can also control the Comet browser for browsing, research and web automation. The page says it creates teams of agents across 20+ frontier models, executes actions in an isolated sandbox, and uses on-device authorization for sensitive steps. Voice mode and starting tasks from an iPhone are also listed.
notable: Single keyboard shortcut summons the agent over any Mac app, with context awareness of the active app
Runs 24/7 on a Mac mini with 2FA, and can be started from an iPhone
Sandboxed execution with on-device authorization for sensitive actions
caveats: Comet browser integration is described as a companion; the page does not state pricing for Personal Computer
Listed in a third-party directory as a companion to Perplexity Computer, which that listing says is limited to Max subscribers at $200/mo; the page itself does not state this
